The keys in the mark category apply to an inline mark phrase.

Key Value Type Example

background-color

Color
(default: 'FFFF00')

 
mark:
  background-color: #FCF8E3

border-offset

Number
(default: 1)

 
mark:
  border-offset: 2

font-color

Color
(default: inherit)

 
mark:
  font-color: #333333

font-style

Font style
(default: inherit)

 
mark:
  font-style: bold
